neighbours.label: the subject (noun or 'It') opening a sentence that explains how a technique, device or treatment works
fire: Engineers needed a cheaper way to clean solar panels. This technique sprays a thin film of water across the surface.
Doctors sometimes widen blocked arteries with a small balloon. The procedure takes about an hour under local anaesthetic.
In 1890 an inventor built a machine to sort census cards. His device read holes punched in each card with metal pins.
Farmers in the region now test soil with a cheap paper strip. This method changes colour when nitrogen levels are low.
Dentists often recommend sealants for children's molars. The treatment forms a plastic coating over the grooves of the tooth.
Biologists track bats with tiny radio tags. This approach lets them follow a single animal for several weeks.
Old ships measured their speed by throwing a log overboard. The device was a wooden board tied to a knotted rope.
Many bakers proof dough overnight in the fridge. This process slows the yeast and develops a deeper flavour.
quiet: Engineers needed a cheaper way to clean solar panels. Their manager asked for a report by the end of the month.
Doctors sometimes widen blocked arteries with a small balloon. My uncle had to wait three weeks for an appointment.
In 1890 an inventor built a machine to sort census cards. He later moved to New York and married a teacher.
Farmers in the region now test soil with a cheap paper strip. Most of them grow wheat, barley and sunflowers.
Dentists often recommend sealants for children's molars. Parents can ask about costs at the front desk.
Biologists track bats with tiny radio tags. Several students joined the team for the summer season.
Old ships measured their speed by throwing a log overboard. Sailors spent months at sea without seeing land.
Many bakers proof dough overnight in the fridge. Our local bakery opens at six every morning except Sunday.

notes: Top examples: 'This technique', 'His device', 'It is often the first choice treatment'. Probe was weak (0.12) and did not separate method from team, so this is a low-confidence guess.
